capabilities.repository-instructions: Project instructions file the tool reads (a marker-delimited ModsPack block is merged in, never overwriting).
capabilities.skill-discovery: The tool finds the installed Agent Skills.
capabilities.skill-invocation: A skill can be invoked by name or picked by description.
capabilities.custom-agents: The six agent roles in the tool's own agent format.
capabilities.agent-delegation: The main session can hand a task to one of the agents.
capabilities.automatic-hooks: Guards run on their own at tool-use time.
capabilities.security-blocking: A guard can refuse a write that adds a secret, personal data or a hardcoded design value.
capabilities.tool-execution: Skills can run the modspack CLI and project scripts.
capabilities.updates: Re-running modspack init updates files it owns and leaves edited ones alone.
capabilities.uninstallation: modspack uninstall removes what it installed and nothing else.
capabilities.ci-integration: Deterministic checks in CI without any AI client.

The same five mods pass the harness (133 tests). Interactive (non-headless) sessions were not re-run here.
